audio_diagnostic_flags_range_valid.name: audio_diagnostic_flags_range_valid
audio_diagnostic_flags_range_valid.value: ("audio_diagnostic_flags"."start_ms" IS NULL AND "audio_diagnostic_flags"."end_ms" IS NULL) OR ("audio_diagnostic_flags"."start_ms" >= 0 AND "audio_diagnostic_flags"."end_ms" > "audio_diagnostic_flags"."start_ms")

audio_measurement_sets_succeeded_complet.name: audio_measurement_sets_succeeded_complete
audio_measurement_sets_succeeded_complet.value: "audio_measurement_sets"."status" <> 'succeeded' OR ("audio_measurement_sets"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL AND "audio_measurement_sets"."series_uri" IS NOT NULL)

audio_preprocessings_started_finished_or.name: audio_preprocessings_started_finished_order
audio_preprocessings_started_finished_or.value: "audio_preprocessings"."finished_at" IS NULL OR "audio_preprocessings"."started_at" IS NULL OR "audio_preprocessings"."finished_at" >= "audio_preprocessings"."started_at"

audio_preprocessings_succeeded_complete.name: audio_preprocessings_succeeded_complete
audio_preprocessings_succeeded_complete.value: "audio_preprocessings"."status" <> 'succeeded' OR ("audio_preprocessings"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL AND "audio_preprocessings"."canonical_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "audio_preprocessings"."normalized_uri" IS NOT NULL AND "audio_preprocessings"."canonical_duration_ms" IS NOT NULL AND "audio_preprocessings"."timeline" IS NOT NULL)

diarization_raw_outputs_scope_window.name: diarization_raw_outputs_scope_window
diarization_raw_outputs_scope_window.value: ("diarization_raw_outputs"."scope" = 'whole' AND "diarization_raw_outputs"."window_start_ms" IS NULL AND "diarization_raw_outputs"."window_end_ms" IS NULL) OR ("diarization_raw_outputs"."scope" = 'window' AND "diarization_raw_outputs"."window_start_ms" IS NOT NULL AND "diarization_raw_outputs"."window_end_ms" IS NOT NULL AND "diarization_raw_outputs"."window_start_ms" >= 0 AND "diarization_raw_outputs"."window_start_ms" < "diarization_raw_outputs"."window_end_ms")
